name: Gripman Gus
blurb: A retired cable-car gripman in a wool cap on a forty-year-old bike. Rings a brass bell before he hits you.

look.description: A cable-car gripman in a navy waistcoat with brass trim, a red neckerchief, a mustache and his cap, a brass bell on a strap round his neck. Rides a moped like it owes him a fare.

meta.notes: San Francisco local (playtest 1c): the old city against the new one, so Pivot is his natural target. A heavy hitter who holds his line like a cable car and never takes the shortcut on purpose.
